verdict.rationale: Expensify documents policy-like controls — Smart Limits on cards, and 'build rules' to configure workspace approval behavior via AI — which map to category/role-based limits with automation, but there is no explicit docs evidence describing a full 'in-policy auto-approves, exceptions route to human' workflow, and independent hands-on reports say the underlying categorization used to judge policy compliance is wrong roughly 70% of the time, which would undermine reliable auto-approval of in-policy items. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a configurable approval matrix by role/category/context, evidence that categorization/limit-checking is accurate enough in practice to safely auto-approve, and confirmation that only true exceptions reach a human reviewer.
